title: fix(auth): the sign-in card says no sign-in method is available instead of SSO-only copy when email+password is off
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbRajEMaatJgToh67sHkQmK1)_

Fixes #29159

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：管理员关掉邮箱密码登录、又没有配 SSO / 第三方登录 / 手机登录时，登录页不再显示「请用组织的单点登录」和一个点进去会被服务器拒绝的「改用密码」链接，而是明确写出「当前没有可用的登录方式，请联系管理员」。
- **为什么改**：原来前端把「邮箱密码关闭」当成「强制 SSO」，整页没有一条能走通的路，用户只能以为系统坏了；登录页应只展示服务器真正提供的登录方式。
- **风险与回滚**：只改登录卡片的显示判断，服务器行为不变；真正开启强制 SSO 的环境照旧显示 SSO 专属视图，读取登录配置失败时照旧退回密码表单。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`（ssoEnforced 只认服务器声明、noSignInMethod 判断、break-glass 链接的条件）；`ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/noSignInMethod-29159.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：在 showcase 上以管理员 `PUT /api/settings/auth {"values":{"email_password_enabled":false}}`，用无痕窗口打开 `/_console/login`，应看到「No sign-in method is available. Contact your administrator.」，没有 SSO 文案，也没有「Use a password instead」。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/auth` `LoginForm`:** SSO enforcement comes only from the server's `features.ssoEnforced`. The server keeps `emailPassword.enabled` true under enforcement (break-glass), so `enabled: false` now reads as "the password door is shut", not as enforcement. Derived state:
  - the password form collapses under declared enforcement or when the password door is shut (as before for both);
  - the SSO line ("Sign in with your organization's single sign-on") is drawn only under declared enforcement or when `features.sso` is true;
  - the "Use a password instead" link is drawn only while the form it opens holds a method the server accepts: email+password, the SSO button (routes the entered email), or phone+password;
  - with the password door shut and no SSO, no social/OIDC provider, no phone+password and no phone OTP, the card shows a `role="status"` line, "No sign-in method is available. Contact your administrator.", with no form, no link and no sign-up link. Social providers are read from the same config read, so the state never paints before the provider list lands.
- **New optional label** `LoginFormLabels.noSignInMethodText`; `auth.login.noSignInMethodText` in all ten locale packs; both login pages (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/LoginPage.tsx`) pass it.
- Unchanged: an SSO-enforced deployment keeps its SSO-only view and break-glass link; a failed `/auth/config` read still falls back to the password form.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/noSignInMethod-29159.test.tsx` (9 cases): the QA config `{emailPassword.enabled:false, features.sso:false, ssoEnforced:false}` shows the no-method state with no SSO copy, no password link, no form, no sign-up (also under `hideHeader` with a translated label); `{ssoEnforced:true, sso:true}` keeps the SSO-only view; declared enforcement with password off keeps the SSO copy without a refused password link; password off with only a provider, with SSO, or with phone sign-in stays usable; a failed fetch keeps the password form.
- `LoginForm.test.tsx`: the old "treats `emailPassword.enabled === false` as enforced" case now pins the new reading.
- Runs at head `8a6b2ec5` (base `49aba82b`), locked, `--maxWorkers=2`:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/auth/` plus the 34 console, app-shell and i18n test files naming LoginForm, LoginPage or auth.login: Test Files 75/75 after the provider-button await fix (first run: one case read the async provider button synchronously, fixed in `8a6b2ec5`); the two new/changed files re-ran three times, 35/35 each.
  - Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: restoring the old derivation (`ssoEnforced === true || emailPassword.enabled === false`) reds 2 of 35: "with password off and only a provider…" and "with password off and phone sign-in on…" (both draw SSO copy again). Mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob `100d93a2` to `c77d644f`), restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. The no-method case itself does not move under that ablation: it is held by `noSignInMethod`, not by the derivation.
  - `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/auth`, `i18n`, `app-shell`, `console`: 74/74 tasks, 0 `error TS`.
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 passed, 2 skipped.
  - After merging `main` (`01252a45`) into head `e1a2c064`: no incoming commit touches the changed files; the same touched set (auth plus 35 consumer files) re-ran 76/76 files, 584/584 tests; the derived gate list is unchanged, and `check-sdui-manifest`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check:nul-bytes` re-ran exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- With the password door shut and `features.sso` true (no enforcement), the email-routed "Sign in with SSO" button is still reached through "Use a password instead", because that button lives inside the password form; the revealed form's password submit is then refused by the server. The same placement holds under declared enforcement with `features.sso` true (pre-existing). A password-less SSO entry is a follow-up shape, not this card.
- Phone+password sign-in (`features.phoneNumber`) counts as a door: better-auth's `/sign-in/phone-number` does not read `emailAndPassword.enabled`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Real browser: password sign-in off on a fresh showcase backend</summary>

Fresh `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT` at `8a6b2ec5`, Console Vite dev server from this tree (it aliases `@object-ui/auth` and `app-shell` to source), Playwright Chromium in a fresh context per locale.

1. As the dev admin, `PUT /api/settings/auth {"values":{"email_password_enabled":false}}` answered 200. `GET /api/v1/auth/config` then read `emailPassword.enabled:false`, `features.sso:false`, `ssoEnforced:false`, `phoneNumber:false`, `phoneNumberOtp:false`, `socialProviders:[]`, and `POST /sign-in/email` answered `400 EMAIL_PASSWORD_DISABLED`.
2. `/login` at 1280x800 (en-US) and 390x844 (zh-CN): the no-method status present (1), SSO copy absent, "Use a password instead" absent (0), password field absent (0). Text: "No sign-in method is available. Contact your administrator." / 「当前没有可用的登录方式，请联系管理员。」
3. Control: `email_password_enabled:true` again, the same pages draw the password field (1) and no status line (0).

The route was the Vite dev server's `/login` (base `/`), not the backend's prebuilt `/_console/login`, which serves the Console built from `main`.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `8a6b2ec5`: 34 families, each run, each exit 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`. `--ran` reconciliation: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
</details>
